value <- pB

t <- 2.132; df <- 6
p <- 2 * pt(abs(t), df, lower.tail = FALSE)
se <- 1.0 / t
sd_d <- se * sqrt(df + 1)
checks <- c(A = abs(sd_d - sqrt(6)) < 0.01, B = abs((1 + 1.96*se) - 2.1477) < 0.001, C = FALSE, D = abs(p - 0.077) < 0.001)
value <- p
answer <- names(checks)[checks][1]
answers.note: Recomputes the two-sided p-value from t with df=6 and checks it against 0.077; the other options do not hold.
